COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
06.11.2024 CRLA No. 664 of 2024
Sri Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.
Sri Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
1. Mr. Priyanshu Gairola, learned counsel for the 
appellant.
2. Mr. K.S. Bora, learned Deputy Advocate General 
for the State.
3. This is an appeal against conviction filed under 
Section 415(2) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha 
Sanhita, 2023.
4. By the impugned judgment dated 05.09.2024 
and sentenced order dated 06.09.2024, passed by 
learned Special Judge (POCSO)/ Additional District 
Judge, Dehradun in Special Sessions Trial No.55 of 
2023, the appellant has been convicted for offence 
punishable under Section 376 IPC and under Section 
3(a)/4(2) of the Protection of Children from Sexual 
Offences Act, 2012 and sentenced to undergo twenty 
years rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.10,000/-
and, in default of payment of fine, he was sentenced 
to undergo additional simple imprisonment for a period 
of one month.
5. As per office report, the appeal is within time.
6. Heard.
7. Admit.
8. Summon the Trial Court Record.
9. If LCR is received, paper-book be prepared and 
supplied to learned counsel for the parties before the  next date of listing, as per Rules.
10. List on 11.02.2025.
11. Objection, if any, to the bail application be filed 
in the meantime.
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.)
 06.11.2024 06.11.2024
NISHANT
